{{Quote|You’ve never owned a Tusede Thirteen. Someone like you would really appreciate the quality. Self-cleaning condenser filters, redundant sensors, magno-shielded intake vents, everything a shrewd buyer like you would want.|Sligh|<ref name="TG">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>}}
The '''Tusede 13''' was a type of [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|moisture vaporator]] used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It had plenty of premium features like redundant sensors, magno-shielded intake vents, and condense filters that are self-cleaning.
